title: Scroll Boxes
description: Upon pickup, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]2[/blue] packs of cards to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Generates 2 random card bundles on pickup. Each bundle contains 2 Commons and 1 Uncommon. For Defect, each bundle has a 1% chance to generate 3x Claw instead. Requires at least 4 unlocked Common cards and 2 unlocked Uncommon cards to be available at Neow.
